0022600201.text: The LA Clippers (1-6, on a six-game losing streak and 13th in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, on a four-game winning streak and 11th in the West), with the Clippers 4.5 games back in the Pacific and the Pelicans 2.5 back in the Southwest. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Pelicans are without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and they have not met yet this season, with the last meeting coming on March 19, 2026, in New Orleans, where the Clippers lost 105-99.
